newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Cantv to issue $150 mln 5-yr yankee bond.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Cantv to issue $150 mln 5-yr yankee bond.

text.p: Venezuelan national telephone company CANTV said it had applied to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Comission (SEC) for approval of an issue of upto $150 million in five year yankee bonds.
The bonds, which will be used to pay-off some of the company's $127.8 million of restructured debt, will be led by Chase Security Inc and co-led by Goldman Sachs, CANTV said in a press release.
Company sources said the bond would be placed in the first quarter of the year, following SEC approval, and would be used to to roll over as well as pay-off debt.
CANTV made its Wall Street debut in November when the company placed some $1 billion of shares on local and international markets in a global offering.
Over one third of the company, or 348 million Class D shares, were sold.
